script.title: Why a Seaworthy Ship Was Found Abandoned at Sea
sentences: In 1872, a ship was found sailing the Atlantic completely deserted.
The Mary Celeste had left New York bound for Genoa with ten people on board.
A passing vessel spotted her moving erratically off the Azores.
When sailors boarded her, they found no signs of fire or violence.
The ship was fully seaworthy, food supplies were ample, and personal belongings lay undisturbed.
The lifeboat was gone, along with the captain's navigational instruments.
The last log entry was dated ten days earlier without mentioning any trouble.
None of the ten people on board were ever seen again.
script.description:
The strange case of the Mary Celeste found adrift in the Atlantic Ocean in 1872.
Discover why her crew and passengers vanished without a trace.
